responsibility: Provides rustc’s MIR interpreter framework for CTFE and related execution: it exposes the module’s public integration surface, defines the machine-parametric execution context, stack model, virtual memory, operand and place representations, and the visitor/validation/interning infrastructure for traversing, checking, and globalizing interpreted values. Within that framework it implements the actual semantics of interpreted MIR by stepping statements and terminators, evaluating unary/binary operators and casts, handling function calls, drops, trait-object/vtable operations, and dispatching interpreter-supported intrinsics such as caller-location and type-name. The files in this module work together to represent values and memory, execute MIR under configurable machine hooks, enforce monomorphization and validity rules, and turn resulting allocations into stable compiler-managed constants.
